findings.text: tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts does not keep a migrated template to copy (plan wording: 'copia de um modelo migrado uma vez'). vitest isolates modules per test file, so a module-level template would be rebuilt per file anyway; instead each createTestDatabase() replays prisma/migrations/*/migration.sql in order through the Prisma adapter's executeScript (milliseconds). The resulting schema is the one `prisma migrate deploy` builds, except there are no _prisma_migrations rows; the real deploy path is covered by scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs.

@types/better-sqlite3 is not in package.json (foundation unit owns it). The TypeScript files avoid importing better-sqlite3 directly (testDatabase.ts uses the adapter's executeScript); only the .mjs smoke scripts import it. A later unit that imports better-sqlite3 from .ts would need the types package added.

scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs seeds rows with raw SQL using the current NOT NULL columns of companies/diagnoses/preferences. A future migration that adds a NOT NULL column without a default to one of them needs seedOwnerData() updated; the failure would be loud (insert error), not silent.

Side effects left in the worktree, all gitignored: server/generated/prisma (from prisma generate), dist/ (vite build ran because the frontend lane's src/ already existed), and an empty data/ (prisma.config.ts -> resolveDatabaseUrl() creates it on any Prisma CLI call). No database file was left in data/; every database used for verification lived in an OS temp folder that was removed.

While reading the shared config files I ran `cat .env`, which printed its single OPENROUTER_API_KEY line into this session's tool output. The value was not copied into any file, report or note. If session transcripts are retained, consider rotating that key.

messages.text: server/db/prismaClient.ts exports `createPrismaClient(databaseUrl = resolveDatabaseUrl()): PrismaClient` (synchronous; the PRAGMAs busy_timeout=5000, journal_mode=WAL and foreign_keys=ON are applied by the adapter factory on each connect, lazily on the first query). server/main.ts should call it and call prisma.$disconnect() on SIGTERM/SIGINT. The PrismaClient type comes from server/generated/prisma/client.ts (run `node scripts/prepare-app.mjs --generate` if the folder is missing).

tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts exports `createTestDatabase(options?: { now?: Date }): Promise<TestDatabase>`. TestDatabase is flat: { prisma, now: () => Date, downloadsDir, databaseUrl, setNow(date), resetData(), dispose() }, so it can be passed straight to createApp(deps) when deps is { prisma, now, downloadsDir } (extra properties are fine because it is a variable, not an object literal). Use beforeAll to create and afterAll to await dispose(); resetData() empties diagnoses, companies and preferences between tests. Default clock is 2026-10-23T12:00:00.000Z.

scripts/prepare-app.mjs exports `APP_ROOT` and `runPackageBin(packageName, args, { env, capture, binName })` (spawns node_modules/<pkg>'s bin with process.execPath, no shell, CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1, returns { status, stdout, stderr }). The steps only run when the file is executed directly, so smoke-boot.mjs / smoke-store-package.mjs can import the helpers. CLI: flags --generate, --migrate, --build; no flag or an unknown flag exits 2 with a usage line; a failing step exits with that step's code; --build skips with a log line when src/ does not exist. For the update simulation in smoke-store-package, scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs shows a working recipe: build a synthetic release with `prisma migrate diff --from-schema <schema> --to-schema <modified copy> --script` (adding a required column to Company yields a RedefineTables migration), name it 99991231235959_smoke_synthetic so it sorts last, and deploy it with `prisma migrate deploy --config <tmp>/prisma.config.mjs` (plain-object config with absolute schema, migrations.path and datasource.url).

pnpm install's postinstall (owned by the foundation unit) now finds scripts/prepare-app.mjs and runs it with --generate --migrate --build. It uses DATABASE_URL when set, else data/fitpulse.db. Re-run `pnpm install` (clean) once all wave-2 units are merged to confirm the full chain; I only ran prepare-app directly with a temp DATABASE_URL, not `pnpm install`.

AC-dm-45 'smoke manual de atualizacao + inspecao do pacote' is only partly covered here: the schema-change/data-preservation half is automated and passing in scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs. The 'datafile never travels in the published package' half belongs to scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs (unit phase-1-backend-package) and the Play store update itself needs a manual walkthrough.
